title: Phoenix Lights footage taken by fake Barwood staffers

tellings.quote: or that night, two men roll up in a unmarked government vehicle and suits and he's like,

plain: After the Phoenix Lights, a wave of strange lights seen over Phoenix, Arizona, in 1997, two men in suits arrived in an unmarked government vehicle and took a witness's footage, claiming to work for Frances Emma Barwood, a Phoenix city councilwoman, when they did not. The filmmaker James Fox tells Michels the story, passing on what he was told. If true, it would mean someone in government quietly collected evidence of the sighting.
